description: Synthetic reconcile-and-close; never treat a generic 404, missing/pruned row, or timeout as definitive absence. Exact request body retries use a fresh transport nonce.
invariant: The work/upload lock checks an exact receipt first. A matching persisted upload can be atomically closed using its server-verified expiry. A delayed commit checks the same fence and cannot accept after closed. A missing or pruned upload and receipt is indeterminate. The close request contains no reservation or result content.
digest_note: commit_body_sha256 and receipt submission_sha256 hash the exact signed HTTP commit body without a domain prefix; commit_sha256 in the multipart fixture hashes the canonical semantic commit with the pharos-teams-typed-result-commit-v2 domain.
